scope: Actual unchanged CMSIS mutex/semaphore wrappers/IRQ predicate;16-byte mutex attributes,80-byte static threshold, robust rejection, recursive LSB tag/untag, task/ISR routing, timeout/status, wake-yield, counts and NULLs
limitations: Kernel mutex/queue constructors, take/give/query and scheduler-state boundaries are fixtures. IRQ/mask registers and ICSR are emulator inputs. No composed queue/scheduler graph, physical interrupts or image instruction identity proof.
